result.title: When GeoFMs Meet VHR: Benchmarking Foundation Models on Very High Resolution Earth Observation Imagery
result.summary: Geospatial foundation models are a widely adopted starting point for remote sensing tasks. Most are pretrained on Sentinel-1/2 and Landsat imagery at a ground sampling distance (GSD) of 10m or coarser. Many applications instead rely on very high resolution (VHR) imagery, where individual buildings, roads, and amenities are resolved. We study which pretraining regimes transfer well to this scale. We introduce VHR-Bench, a benchmark suite of ten datasets at 1.5m GSD or finer spanning five task families, eight application domains, and both satellite and aerial platforms. We evaluate twelve encoders in three pretraining tiers with frozen backbones at two training-data fractions. We find that both pretraining on large natural-image collections and VHR-specific pretraining transfer effectively to VHR tasks, with complementary strengths. SkySense leads when labels are scarce; at the full label fraction the web-pretrained DINOv3 ViT-L edges ahead, with the two close together there. Encoders pretrained only on Sentinel-scale imagery transfer least well under RGB input. Guided by these complementary results, we continue the self-supervised pretraining of DINOv3 ViT-L on 1.02 million held-out VHR tiles and evaluate the resulting encoder without changing the downstream protocol. The continued model gives a clear improvement over the released backbone when labels are scarce and a modest one at the full fraction, at no increase in inference parameters or compute. These findings support a generalize-then-specialize strategy: already strong, broad natural-image pretraining can be further improved by a short VHR continuation stage while preserving its general visual features.

AI.brief_summary: 该文构建 VHR-Bench（10 个 1.5m 以下 GSD 数据集、5 类任务），在冻结骨干、两种标签比例下比较 12 个编码器的三类预训练方案，并进一步在百万级 VHR 切片上继续自监督预训练 DINOv3 ViT-L，发现「先通用再特化」可带来增益。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究焦点是遥感高分辨率场景下编码器的预训练迁移与下游精度，未涉及 latent 推理状态生成、证据筛选、动态计算或停止决策；高分辨率细节只体现在输入尺度与领域预训练层面，未分析内部表示如何使用，故缺少可核查的 LVR 借鉴线索。
